instrument: NOT the generated differential harness. `vit test-validate` compares a unit's MAPPED OUTPUTS and `Debug` assigns nothing in its own signature -- `ErrVar` only on GetNewUnit's unit-number-exhaustion arm, which does not exist once GetNewUnit is absorbed, and `avrSWAP` never. A generated harness for this unit would compare the empty set. What is checked here is the unit's actual contract: the BYTES of the .RO.dbg files it writes.
measures: CAN see: every value and every column the three log files carry, at the exact byte. CANNOT see: the WRITE(*,100) status line, which goes to unit 6 and not to a file; a buffer allocated larger than it needs to be; and any branch no input in this tree reaches. See evidence/Debug/mutation.md.
what_is_compared: Each record of every *.RO.dbg* file the scenarios write, byte for byte, against an archive produced by a build whose Debug was still FORTRAN. Record 1 is compared byte for byte too and falls back to a structural check only when it differs and both sides carry the 'Generated on ...' shape, whose two fields are a wall clock.
